subject.title: feat(localization): add locale context and message rendering

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `@openclaw/localization-core` and its process/user/request locale-precedence rules as a permanent cross-surface product boundary before the cumulative localization series proceeds?
rationale: The branch introduces a new shared runtime package, precedence policy, Gateway metadata convention, generated inventory gate, and multiple consumer integrations; code review cannot safely choose the lasting product and ownership boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor a staged shared runtime
options.body: Approve a narrowly documented foundation contract, land it only after rebase and real behavior proof, then review later adoption slices independently.

options.title: Keep localization surface-owned
options.body: Ask for smaller surface-local improvements and defer a shared package until a maintainer-owned RFC defines the required core seam.

options.title: Pause the series
options.body: Close or defer the draft series if the repository does not want to own localization runtime, inventory, and CI policy at this time.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a staged shared runtime
recommendation.body: Approve a narrowly documented foundation contract, land it only after rebase and real behavior proof, then review later adoption slices independently.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main ownership attribution could not be completed in the read-only environment; a repository localization/CLI/Control UI decision owner should be selected from current history and CODEOWNERS.
